details: The first v1.0.33 production launch failed closed on a tracked 2,484,371-byte JSON blob before creating loop 138.
An independent shell read proved the exact commit and path were valid and emitted 2,484,371 bytes.

The resulting manifest binds the World Model and the persisted entity SHA-256 matches the exact producer bytes.
Every sorted test file completed with zero failures under bun run test:ci.
